newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area on Monday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers; 1,400 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Mostly Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 68.00.
Wk to Date - 1,400 Week Ago - 21,400 Year Ago - 19,700
